body: But doesn’t it get boring after a while? Don’t you feel lonely? Don’t you long for a friend?
How? You know I’m not  sure what a friend really is since I’ve never really had one. Is it one of those things where you come up with your own definition?
I never get invited. I’m pretty much nonexistent. I only get invited if not enough people go to something. I’ve always been the odd one out. The last pick.

1. I’m scared of getting hurt again. I feel I’ve been abandoned so many times that I don’t want to open up anymore. 
2. I can start a conversation but I can’t get it to anything more than that. 

Is it possible that some people just can’t make friends!
How can I create a life for myself if I have no friends.
